episodes.paragraph: Mia is in her bedroom before school. Her shirt and skirt are on the chair. Her school bag is near the door. Mia can get dressed by herself.

target_chunk_surfaces: can email a picture to a friend
episodes.paragraph: Ben is at the library computer area. A picture is on the screen, and his friend is at home. Ben can email a picture to a friend. His message is short. The computer is ready.
Anna is in the living room with her little brother. A toy box is near the sofa. Her brother is beside the box. Anna can help a child with the toys.

Tom is in his bedroom after school. Two books are on the floor, and a small box is near the desk. Tom can clean a room by himself. His bag is under the chair. The floor is clear. The room is ready for homework.
Nina is in the kitchen after lunch. A plate is near the sink. A towel is on the table. Nina can wash a plate by herself. The kitchen is tidy.
Leo is in the school media room. A camera is on the table, and his friend is near the class display. Leo can take a photo of the display. The picture is clear.
Ben is in the music room with Mia. A song card is on the piano. The room is quiet and bright. Ben can sing with a friend. Mia can sing with him too.
Anna is in the park on a windy afternoon. A red kite is on the grass. Her friend is near the open field. Anna can fly a kite in the clear area. The path is near them. The park is bright.
Mia is in the classroom reading corner. A short story is in her book. Her teacher is near the table. Mia can read a short story by herself.
Tom is on the playground with a soft ball. His friend is a few steps away. A bench is near the fence. Tom can catch a ball with both hands. He is ready for the game.

Nina is in the town centre with a simple map. The station is near the bus stop on the map. Her friend is beside her. Nina can find the station on the map. The route is clear. Their bags are near the bench.

target_chunk_surfaces: can walk to school with a friend
episodes.paragraph: Leo is near his home before class. His friend is beside him, and their school bags are light. The school gate is at the end of the safe path. Leo can walk to school with a friend.
